trust_decision.summary: Whether a request-supplied post-login/post-logout redirect target (redirectUrl parameter) is server-local or same-site before the response redirects to it; decided separately in the logout handler, the Keycloak and OIDC login filters, and (not at all) in the Spring form-login success handler.

landing_point.why: The only existing same-site check for redirectUrl; its startsWith("/") shortcut lets protocol-relative //host values through, which is the obvious 'bypass' the summary names.

fix_sites.module_kind: logout success handler (core security, jeeves package)

fix_sites.entry_point: HTTP POST /signin with redirectUrl (formLoginFilter, config-security-core.xml:152-184); fix adds new class GeonetworkSavedRequestAwareAuthenticationSuccessHandler (fix.diff:81-153)
fix_sites.module_kind: Spring XML bean wiring of a framework success handler (no project Java code at pinned commit)

fix_sites.entry_point: Keycloak interactive login callback with redirectUrl query param (config-security-keycloak.xml:84)
OIDC login callback with redirectUrl query param (config-security-openidconnect.xml:75, config-security-openidconnectbearer.xml:82)
new shared helper RedirectUtil.isRelativeRedirect / isSafeRedirect / sendSafeRedirect used by all sites

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: web/src/main/webapp/WEB-INF/config-security/config-security-core.xml:172-178 (form login uses stock Spring SavedRequestAwareAuthenticationSuccessHandler with targetUrlParameter=redirectUrl and no check; fix wraps it in a subclass and rewires the bean)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The form-login redirect is handled entirely by an unmodified Spring Security class configured in XML, so a solver can argue it is framework behaviour, not GeoNetwork code; the CAS logout handler is a separate optional auth profile with a different parameter name ('redirect') whose default target is already an external CAS URL.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Absolute same-site URLs must still be honoured: the UI posts redirectUrl=window.location.href on sign-in and an absolute same-site prefix on sign-out; the logout default target and CAS default target (${cas.logout.url}) are absolute URLs that must not be filtered. A fix that only allows '/path' breaks login/logout return-to-page.

null/empty parameter (falls back to default/context home)
